title: EMC English Conversation Club
description:
**EMC English Conversation Club**
**Thursdays, 4 to 6pm**
**Free.** Please **join this group** and **reserve** your seat every week.

Whether you want to improve your English or you're a native speaker keen to help others, this is a great place to connect and build friendships.
This is not a classroom. It’s a relaxed community space where you can share stories, practise everyday English, and learn about life, work, and culture in New Zealand and other countries.
Each session is guided by an experienced facilitator and supported by friendly volunteers.
**What to expect:**
• Casual, friendly conversations on real-life topics
• Supportive facilitators and volunteers
• Language learning through connection, not pressure
• A welcoming environment to build friendships and confidence

Please **join this group** and **reserve** your seat every week.

title: 0x25 Auckland Meetup at AUT CSI
location: 74 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**WHAT TO EXPECT**
Join us for another Hack The Box meetup in Auckland! Whether you're thinking about being a hacker or are already a seasoned one, this event has something for everyone.

**A massive shoutout to AUT Cyber Security & Intelligence (CSI) Club for opening their doors to us and sponsoring the event venue and catering.**

The event will include a guided walk through of a security challenge, demonstrating essential tools and techniques for enumeration, exploitation, and privilege escalation. Attendees will have the opportunity to network and collaborate with other members.

At the end, we will do a raffle where we will give out HTB prizes, such as VIP access to the platform and HTB Academy cubes.

This is an on-site event in Auckland CBD.

**WHAT YOU GET**

* A chance to win some HTB giveaways
* Access to our HTB dedicated lab during the event

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* A laptop.
* A HTB account.
* Discord application.

**HOUSE RULES**

* Follow all rules and guidelines in the **[HTB TOS: HTB Terms of Service](https://www.hackthebox.com/tos)**
* Active HTB content cannot be shared publicly. Retired challenges or machines are fair game.
* **AUT CSI Club** host the event to support the growth of the local cybersecurity community and to support students and professionals in their journeys to learn. Respect for the venue and people is expected from all attendees.

**ADDITIONAL NOTES**

* Join our Discord for event discussion, upcoming event announcements, and CTFs here: **[https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu](https://discord.gg/aDWymsDxWu)**
* Free parking is not available at the location.

* Smoking

* Any other forms of misconduct

title: From Vibe Coding to Production AI on AWS
location: Level 19, Vero Centre, 48 Shortland Street, Auckland CBD, Auckland
description:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the September edition of the Auckland AWS Tools & Programming Meetup! This month, we are diving deep into the lifecycle of building and scaling AI-powered products—from a single idea and "vibe coding" all the way to robust engineering practices for production systems on AWS.

🚨 **Action Required:** To help us streamline building security and sort out the catering (including dietary requirements), please make sure to pre-register before arriving: 👉 **[Pre-register for Venue Check-In Here](https://eventspaces.app/e/auckland-aws-tools-and-programming-meetup-sept-24-from-vibe-coding-to-production-ai-on-aws-a9b5de/register)**

Join us for an exciting double-header exploring the realities of shipping real software:

**Speaker 1: Dinesh Sharma**
**From Zero to Qazo: Building a Product with Kiro, AI & AWS**

**About the Talk:** "I started Qazo with a simple idea and used Kiro and AI to turn it into a real product, eventually deploying it on AWS. This session is about that journey — what worked, what didn't, the lessons I learned from vibe coding, and why I think everyone should try building something of their own to experience the full journey from idea → build → break → learn → deploy."
🔗 **Check out Qazo:** [https://qazo.net](https://qazo.net)

**Speaker 2: Dinesh Liyanage**

**After the Demo: From Vibe Coding to AI Engineering**
**About the Talk:** "I pick up from where Dinesh's session ends. Vibe coding gets you to a working product, and that's genuinely new, but a demo and a product with paying customers are different animals. I'll go through what breaks on the way between them and the engineering practices that fix it:

* **Evals** so prompt changes stop being guesswork.
* **Tracing** so you can reproduce the bad output a customer reported.
* **Cost and model routing** so unit economics survive growth.
* **Context engineering** so quality doesn't quietly rot as you add data.

title: On Body and Soul (Hungary 2015, 1 hr 50)
description:
I am really excited about showing this film. It was nominated for the Academy Aaward for Best Foreign Language Film and won the Golden Bear Award at the Berlin International Film Festival.

The film depicts a romance in which two people share a re-occuring dream - that they are a pair of deer in a forest. The film is beautifully shot (you will love deer after this). A lot could be said about this film, but it takes us into world of autism and socially damaged indiividuals

The Fictionmachine reviewer wrote "technically it is superb. Cinematographer Máté Herbai turns every shot into a beautifully composed painting. The film’s use of colour is superb. The scenes of the two deer are remarkable to watch, and capture the animals in such an emotive fashion."

Some won't get it, but nothing new in thw world of cinema there!
